summary: Quick filter working much slower after Supernova redesign
description:
User Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/118.0

Steps to reproduce:

Typing anything in Quick Filter

Actual results:

Nothing. For 5-10 seconds, nothing happens.
Only after that, the results are listed.

Expected results:

Before Supernova redesign, the result were in less than 1 second. And if I remember correctly, they updated gradually (some of then quickly, some later).
It should work like before. With the 5+ seconds wait it's unbearable. I use quick filters all the time...

(visually, I like the redesign)
